run_dqn_skat_training: run DQN agents trained on Skat by independent Q-learning with configurable hyperparameters
eval_against_random_bots: evaluate trained DQN agents against random bots for a specified number of episodes
create_dqn_agents: create DQN agents with configurable hidden layers, replay buffer capacity, and batch size
create_rl_environment: create an OpenSpiel RL environment for the Skat game with observation and action specs
create_random_agents: create random agents for evaluation with specified player IDs and number of actions
